messages:
kai: Heads-up — I'm filing a quota escalation with GCP for org project `inference-prod-2`. We need: H100 x 6 (regional), L4 x 12 (burst), 200 static external IPs for burst pools, and bump regional network egress limit for us-west1 by 6 Gbps. Linking billing is blocked by the org policy, need help from finance/cloud-ops.
neha: Can you paste the exact numbers (vCPU/GPU) and the business justification? GCP will ask for sustained utilization + cost center.
kai: Quick details: steady inference workload ~400 qps (short contexts), peak burst up to 1.2k qps during batch jobs. Primary models: rt-7b-quant (L4) and rt-70b-ptq (H100). Memory/slot mapping: H100 nodes will be 4x A100-like pods, we want 6 GPUs here for redundancy and canary pools. Estimated monthly GPU hours: ~43k h across both regions. Cost impact ~ $180k/mo if on-demand; financial commit TBD.
ralph: org policy is blocking project linking because `billing-host` isn't authorized to attach shared VPC for new projects. I'll escalate to finance. Also need a service account pre-provisioned for quotas so support can validate ownership.
maria: For the static IPs: can we reduce to 120? 200 seems high — are these per-region ephemeral addresses? We're using them for egress NAT for dedicated pools right?
kai: They're for burst pool NAT + some dedicated endpoints (customer VPNs). 120 could work if we reserve per-pool and share across canaries. I'll trim and update the request.
neha: Also, GCP will ask for expected sustained throughput per VM and whether these GPUs are preemptible. Are we requesting preemptible quota or sole tenant? Clarify.
kai: Not preemptible for H100 (prod inference), L4 burst pools can be preemptible. Will specify: H100 non-preemptible, L4 mix (6 preemptible, 6 non-preemptible).
cloud-ops-bot: deploy-bot: quota_request_template.json created at gs://redwood-ops/quota-requests/inference-prod-2/2069507777.json
kai: Pasting the gcloud snippet I used to gather current quotas:

```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=inference-prod-2 \n  --format="json(quotas)"

# sample output trimmed for reviewers
```

kai: Draft justification (short): "Redwood Inference production workload for customer-facing inference requires low-latency regional capacity. Requesting H100 and L4 GPUs plus static IPs to support burst pools, canary rollouts, and cross-zone redundancy. Expected steady-state utilization justifies quota increase; this enables traffic failover and reduces SLO breaches during seasonal spikes."
ralph: Please add exact SLOs and the incident cost if we don't get capacity (e.g., estimated revenue impact or error budget burn). That helps approvals.
kai: Added: SLO = 99.9% p99 < 1200ms for RT-7b and < 2200ms for RT-70b; projected customer-visible errors + 8% if we can't run canaries during rollout. Estimated mitigation spend (engineering + cloud) $45k per week during outages.
maria: I'll own the static IP ask and see if we can do NAT64 + shared egress to cut numbers. Also cc-ing finance to expedite billing link: @ralph please share the finance contact.
ralph: Looping in finance: @neha_finance — need approval to link `inference-prod-2` to billing-host. Without that we can't have quota escalations processed under our org.
neha_finance: Looking now, need cost forecast and expected commit term. Can we provide 3-month forecast and whether we want committed use discounts?
kai: 3-month forecast attached in the request payload (breakdown by GPU type + networking). We'll evaluate CUDs if we get predictable utilization after month 2.
cloud-ops-bot: support-ticket: Case ST-88321 created with GCP for expedited quota review. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/ST-88321
sre-bot: incident-signal: Noted — if quota is delayed, fallback plan is to route low-priority traffic to hosted Redwood API for degraded latency.
eha: minor typo: reply-to finance contact is `neha_finance`, not `neha`. Also, can we include a simple network diagram in the ticket to justify the egress increase? GCP likes layout for NAT, shared VPC, and peering.
kai: Good call — attaching basic ASCII diagram in the ticket body.

```
US-WEST1
  |-- shared-vpc (hub)
       |-- inference-prod-2 (service project)
       |-- nat-gateways x3 => static IP pool (planned 120)
       |-- peering -> analytics-prod (for logging)
```

maria: Thanks. I'll try to compress IP needs to 120 and confirm whether 6 Gbps bump can be split across two subnets instead of one region-wide bump.
kai: Timeline: we need approval by EOD Fri to hit the next canary window Mon. If GCP approves earlier, we'll spin nodes late Sat and run validation Sunday.
ralph: I'll ping finance and escalate the billing link. Also pre-approving the technical justification from infra side — pending cost sign-off.
neha_finance: Received — will review the attached 3-month forecast and respond by tomorrow AM. If approved, I'll enable billing link and notify cloud-ops.
kai: Thanks everyone. I'll update the support case with trimmed IP count and the SLO details.
maria: :thumbsup: :rocket:
ralph: :eyes: keeping an eye on billing-ops thread
cloud-ops-bot: quota-update: GCP support requested additional utilization graphs and a contact phone number for org verification. Please update case ST-88321.
kai: Uploading CPU/GPU utilization graphs (last 30 days) and a contact: ops-billing@redwood.com. Done.
cloud-ops-bot: support-case ST-88321 updated by kai at 2069508033
sre-bot: alert: If approval delayed beyond 2069509000 we'll trigger fallback partitioning plan and notify product owners.
kai: closing loop — will post final approval once GCP replies. Thanks all for quick turns on this.
